image_description: A close-up view of a silver car wheel mounted on a grey vehicle. The wheel features a five-spoke alloy rim with a polished finish and a central emblem. A black rubber tire with visible tread patterns surrounds the rim. The wheel is situated within the wheel well, showing part of the fender and side skirt.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The object is clearly circular and proportionate to a standard automotive wheel.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The geometry matches: there is a distinct outer lip where the tire sits, and the spokes recede towards the center hub.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rubber tire mounted around outer edge.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A black rubber tire is clearly mounted on the rim.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The wheel features a clear five-spoke alloy design.

artifact_observations.reasoning: There is white text/decals on the car body in the upper left. The characters are nonsensical and malformed, typical of AI-generated text artifacts.

artifact_observations.location: Tire sidewall and ground contact patch
artifact_observations.reasoning: The tire sidewall lacks crisp molding lines or brand lettering, appearing slightly 'mushy' or overly smooth compared to the sharpness of the rim. The contact patch with the ground lacks realistic compression deformation.
The logo/emblem in the very center of the wheel is distorted and lacks geometric symmetry, appearing melted or ill-defined rather than a crisp manufacturer badge.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a car wheel and not a similar mechanical disc.
To check for boundary bleeding between the tire and the rim, and between the wheel and the background.
To analyze the gibberish text observed on the car body for severity and coherence.
To assess overall sharpness, lighting consistency, and subtle texture anomalies in the metal and rubber.

focus_areas: Integrity of the center hub emblem
Clarity and realism of tire tread and sidewall details
Legibility and structure of background text/decals
Boundary sharpness between rim and tire
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the center hub logo; AI often fails to render symmetrical emblems correctly. Also, verify if the 'gibberish' text on the car body is an artifact or just out-of-focus real text. Check if the tire tread pattern remains consistent around the curve or if it warps unnaturally.
